title: Add bounded status waits to command recipes
changes: Add typed status waits with explicit timeout, interval and poll budgets; preserve serialization for recipes without waits.
Persist the completed action and reserve each read before polling so a resumed wait does not reissue the action or extend its original budget.
validation: Windows GNU targeted test binary compiled and 30 focused Wine tests passed, including matched status waits, exhausted poll budgets, cancellation/resume without repeating the action, input bounds and existing recipe/control contracts.

Two sandboxed Wine attempts failed before tests because the server lock location was read-only. Their exact owned leases were released after host process checks; diagnostics were retained. A native Linux build attempt failed for missing ALSA development metadata and temporary-file quota exhaustion.
Generated menu atlas inventory, project memory and handoff checks passed.
limitations: Wait tests used a synthetic server; real interrupted recovery, real sessions and native Windows remain unverified. Status polls observe external state and do not advance a paused guest. Broader recipe actions and interactive Start remain open.
